description: This file defines a culture info object for the Uzbek (Latin, Uzbekistan) locale, including date and time formatting patterns, localization strings, regex patterns for date parsing, and extensions to the Date object for culture-specific date operations.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object’s time to the current local time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current date with time cleared.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Date objects, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines whether a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date object with the same time as the original.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if the Date object is equal to another date.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Checks if the date falls between two other dates.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if the date is after another date.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if the date is before another date.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if the date is today.

methods.name: isSameDay
methods.description: Checks if two dates are on the same calendar day.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the date.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds seconds to the date.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Adds minutes to the date.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Adds hours to the date.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Adds days to the date.

methods.name: addWeeks
methods.description: Adds weeks to the date.

methods.name: addMonths
methods.description: Adds months to the date.

methods.name: addYears
methods.description: Adds years to the date.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Returns the week number of the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Returns the ISO 8601 week number of the date.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the week of the date to a specific number.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a given weekday in the month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific day of the week, optionally with direction.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific month, optionally with direction.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the day within its month.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset for the date.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone for the date.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if daylight saving time is observed.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if daylight saving time is currently in effect.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the milliseconds elapsed since the date.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts the date to ISO string format.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats the date as a string based on a specified pattern.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components based on configuration.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specified day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specified month.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Calculates the week number for the date.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the week of the year for the date.
